title: Design a Ticket Booking System
prompt: Design a ticket booking system (like Ticketmaster) for high-demand events: many users try to book seats for the same popular show at the same time, and each seat can only be sold once.
requirements: Functional: browse available seats for an event, hold a seat temporarily while a user checks out, confirm or release the hold, pay and finalize the booking
Non-functional: no double-booking of a seat under heavy concurrent demand, fair handling of a traffic spike when tickets go on sale
discussion_points: Preventing double-booking under concurrency (locking, optimistic concurrency, or a queue-based approach)
Seat-hold expiration — what happens if a user abandons checkout mid-flow
Handling a massive traffic spike at on-sale time (queueing/waiting-room patterns)
Data model for events, seats, holds, and confirmed bookings
Payment integration and what happens if payment fails after a seat was held
